description.text: Must see views from back lanai that you will enjoy daily! Come experience 55+ living in Del Webb Naples with tons of activities in the town of Ave Maria, FL and close to Naples, FL! Full access to Del Webb clubhouse with resort pool, lap pool, steam/sauna, hot tub, virtual golf simulator, pickleball, bocce ball, tennis and golf! Activities director on site with many planned festivities. Join right in! Golf Cart use included with rental after signing waiver. You can drive golf cart into town of Ave Maria for shopping and dining or to the Del Webb clubhouse. This home is 2 bedrooms, 2 bath, plus den. Home has porcelain tile throughout and Impact glass. Screened in back lanai and extended patio gives you some of the best views Del Webb has and is very private! The exposure is East and South from the back lanai. A screened in front porch offers views of grass lands and woods and great for sunsets! Master is King size bed. 2nd bedroom is Queen. All couches have reclining feature. Golf Cart available for use after signing waiver with landlord. Panther Run golf course is available to guests as tee times allow. Come make yourself at home!

description.text: Enjoy resort-style living in Del Webb Naples with this unfurnished three-bedroom annual rental. The home features tile flooring throughout, a beautifully remodeled kitchen, and a custom-designed closet in the primary suite. Relax on the screened lanai while taking in gorgeous southeast-facing waterfront and golf course views. Ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac street within a gated 55+ community, with no nearby construction. Tenants receive full access to the clubhouses, resort-style amenities, and extensive calendar of activities. Golf is available on a pay-to-play basis at Panther Run, subject to availability. Del Webb's exceptional amenities, include 2 clubhouses, resort and lap pools, pickleball, tennis, bocce, a state-of-the-art fitness center, golf simulator, steam room, sauna, billiards, library, and an active calendar of clubs, events, and social activities. Head into the charming town of Ave Maria for restaurants, shopping, farmers markets, concerts, and year-round community events. Here, neighbors become friends, every day feels like a vacation, and life moves at just the right pace. Come enjoy one of Southwest Florida's most sought-after 55+ communities today. Ave Maria ~ Once you get here, you get it.
